pages.title: Supernova Remnant
pages.text: The expanding shell of gas and the collapsed core left when a massive star's core can no longer support itself. The shockwave seeds space with heavy elements. This remnant is a dense nugget wrapped in a faint, glowing haze of debris.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Neutron Star Forge I collapsed a stellar iron core under neutronium pressure and flooded it with neutrinos. The red giant envelope blew outward and left a small, heavy remnant.
